what_happened: Job 20261017-205554-zaj2 ("Hide other studies from study jobs; configure Hermes Agent as a system", code) ended failed. The producer made no change. Its report, kept in invocations/14-producer.json, still had problems when it was sent back. Five acceptance criteria were unmet or not reported: (1) a cargo test that parses the real athena.toml and shows Hermes pinned at v2026.9.24 while firstmate keeps its SHA pin; (2) a cargo test showing study job snapshots for the reader, producer and verifier hold only the named study, while change jobs hold both; (3) a cargo test showing a hidden study directory is never reported as deleted and studies/a is unchanged after a study job runs to landing; (4) athena.toml containing the hermes-agent system entry with the repo URL and ref, firstmate unchanged; (5) a CHANGELOG.md entry covering study snapshot isolation, the hidden-directory landing rule and Hermes. No failed checks are listed. Nothing was delivered and the cause of the empty run is not recorded.
cause: The request bundles two separable changes into one producer run: a code change to snapshot isolation and landing rules, with several tests, and a config and changelog change for a new system. Nothing sizes the job against what one producer run can finish before its deadline, or splits it. When the producer ends with an empty diff, nothing records why (already done, blocked, gave up) or keeps partial progress, so the failure carries no diagnosis. The report was sent back once and still did not map to the criteria.
prevention: Add a check before dispatch that splits a request spanning separable surfaces (core snapshot and landing code with tests, versus config and changelog) into one job per change, ordered by dependency. Also require a producer that ends with an empty diff to record a reason and any partial progress, so a rerun starts from that result and the failure can be diagnosed.
proposed_request: Make study jobs see only the study they name. Outcome: in a test repository with studies/a and studies/b, the reader, producer and verifier snapshots of a study job naming b hold studies/b and not studies/a, while a change job's snapshots hold both. A hidden study directory is never reported as deleted in a change list, and studies/a is byte-identical after a fake-driver study job naming b runs to landing. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry describing study snapshot isolation and the hidden-directory landing rule. Do not touch athena.toml; adding Hermes Agent as a system is a separate follow-up job. If the producer makes no change, it must state why.
